text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We usually only use the word "sakura,"
but there
are many kinds of sakura trees.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Someiyoshino, shidarezakura,
yamazakura,
kanhizakura... That's just to
name a few.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Baku never stops moving forward, so
she's a
kanhizakura. Chiyo has strong
roots like a
yamazakura. They're both
"sakura" but the
flowers they bloom are
unique.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I wonder what kind of sakura I'll
turn out to
be. What do you think,
Trainer?
